title: Duckling reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Book -->
  <rect x='25' y='62' width='50' height='26' rx='3' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <rect x='27' y='64' width='46' height='22' rx='2' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='64' x2='50' y2='86' stroke='#c0392b' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Book pages lines -->
  <line x1='30' y1='70' x2='47' y2='70' stroke='#d4a373' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='30' y1='75' x2='47' y2='75' stroke='#d4a373' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='30' y1='80' x2='47' y2='80' stroke='#d4a373' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='70' x2='70' y2='70' stroke='#d4a373' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='75' x2='70' y2='75' stroke='#d4a373' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='80' x2='70' y2='80' stroke='#d4a373' stroke-width='1.2'/>

  <!-- Duckling body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='20' ry='18' fill='#f7c531'/>
  <!-- Body lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='14' ry='10' fill='#ffe27a'/>

  <!-- Wings holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='63' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#e8b31b' transform='rotate(-20 30 63)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='63' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#e8b31b' transform='rotate(20 70 63)'/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='33' r='16' fill='#f7c531'/>
  <!-- Head highlight -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='28' r='6' fill='#ffe27a'/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='32' r='3.2' fill='#2c3e50'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='32' r='3.2' fill='#2c3e50'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='31' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='31' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- Beak -->
  <path d='M45 39 Q50 46 55 39 Q50 42 45 39 Z' fill='#e67e22'/>
  <path d='M45 39 Q50 43 55 39' stroke='#d35400' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>

  <!-- Tiny tuft/head feather -->
  <path d='M48 17 Q52 10 56 16 Q53 15 51 18 Z' fill='#e8b31b'/>

  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='38' r='2.5' fill='#ff9a9a' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='38' r='2.5' fill='#ff9a9a' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
